status: complete; final official measurements use the delivered code; exploratory results are diagnostic

method.build: release; final baseline and candidate executable SHA-256 hashes checked distinct
method.order: alternate baseline/candidate order over repetitions; one experiment at a time
method.timing: corrected runs block on child exit and use a separate timer for the emergency deadline
method.sat_timeout: per exact endpoint; CNF generation and loading are outside the solver deadline
method.unknown: reported separately; never treated as an unreachability proof
method.correctness: all returned OK certificates replayed by independent coordinate-based Python rules; known oracle labels checked; decided statuses cross-checked across encodings, engines, revisions and repetitions
method.limits: measurements concern these corpora and budgets; short runs can be noisy; time-limited timings are censored; tests and differential checks do not constitute a general proof of every UNSAT result

historical_corpus.recipe: append one space and b to each 64-character relative board, keeping order and multiplicity
historical_corpus.meaning: the appended Black turn defines these benchmark queries; no historical reachability label is imported; LP-filter passage is not proof of reachability

cross_experiment_check.lp_excluded: LP passage is not proof of reachability, so LP filter statuses do not enter the OK/NG cross-check.

placement_ablation.role: diagnostic; A and B were rejected and are not delivered

lp_exact_certificate_cost.role: correctness cost; not a reachability-OK comparison
lp_exact_certificate_cost.recipe: append one space and b to each source row; historical labels are not an oracle
lp_exact_certificate_cost.timing: blocking subprocess wait, alternating revision order
lp_exact_certificate_cost.interpretation: An exact certificate could not be verified for three inputs, so they remain undetermined; this does not prove the old verdict was wrong. LP passage is only a necessary-condition result and is not a reachability certificate.

commit_mapping.note: Connector-created remote commits have the same Git tree as their local code commits; executable provenance uses the local commits.

certificates.scope: Both revisions of final official SAT runs; duplicates removed only when every CSV field agrees.
